unit_id: Unique unit code. Never change it once set; the demo matches sheet rows to units by this code.
listing_title: Headline shown on the listing card.
property_type: Office, Coworking, Retail shop, Showroom, F&B space, Clinic, Institutional, Warehouse or Industrial shed.
grade: Building grade A, B or C (A = newest, best specs and management).
unit_no: Unit, floor or bay label inside the building.
locality: Locality or micro-market used for search and matching.
lat: Latitude, used for distance in matching.
permitted_uses: Uses the building allows, separated by semicolons.
carpet_sqft: Usable floor area inside the walls, in sq ft.
super_builtup_sqft: Carpet area plus share of common areas (lobby, corridors, lifts).
chargeable_sqft: Area the rent is billed on. Usually equals super built-up.
loading_pct: Loading = (super built-up minus carpet) divided by carpet, as a percentage, rounded. Shows how much of the billed area is common area.
pricing_model: Per sq ft, or Per seat for coworking.
rent_per_sqft: Monthly rent per chargeable sq ft, in rupees, before GST.
monthly_rent: rent_per_sqft x chargeable_sqft, rounded to the nearest 5.
seats: Coworking only: seats in the space.
price_per_seat: Coworking only: monthly price per seat.
cam_per_sqft: Common area maintenance per sq ft per month.
all_in_per_sqft: rent_per_sqft + cam_per_sqft. This is the number occupiers compare and the match uses.
deposit_months: Security deposit in months of rent.
negotiable: Owner's stated room on rent: Yes, Slightly, No.
brokerage_months: Brokerage the desk earns, in months of rent.
furnishing: Bare shell, Warm shell, Semi-furnished or Plug-and-play.
frontage_ft: Shops and showrooms: road frontage in feet. Blank if not applicable.
clear_height_ft: Warehouses and sheds: clear height in feet.
road_width_ft: Width of the road the building faces.
fire_noc: Fire safety certificate on file: Yes or No.
occupancy_certificate: Occupancy certificate on file: Yes or No.
building_age_years: Age of the building in years.
highlights: Up to four selling points shown on the card.
status: Available, Under negotiation, LOI signed or Leased. Only Available units go to occupiers.
available_from: Date the unit can be handed over (YYYY-MM-DD).
last_confirmed: Last date the owner confirmed availability and terms. Units not confirmed for 14 days drop out of matching.
confirmed_via: WhatsApp reply, Call or Site visit.
listing_agent: Team member who owns the listing.
data_flag: Warning shown to the team. A flagged unit is never sent automatically.
